description:
Configure a real-time carbon monitoring pipeline. 

1. Go to the Inputs page. Find the input 'facility_main_power' (Node: main_meter). 
2. Configure its Input Processing to: 
   a. Scale to kW (multiply by 0.001). 
   b. Apply Carbon Factor (multiply by 0.475). 
   c. Log to a new Feed named 'current_carbon_intensity' (Tag: Environment). 
3. Create a Dashboard named 'Sustainability_Display'. 
4. Add a Dial (or Gauge) widget to the dashboard linked to the 'current_carbon_intensity' feed. Set the max value to 100. 
5. Save the dashboard.
